title: Big City
summary: Lillith starts, Rubella answers, Kenji spoken tag. Small Glamora club stage as A-roll; B-roll is inappropriately huge hair as architecture — skyline, fire-escape strands, lunch-volume dos, ELO afros in slow-motion argument. Product off-screen. Not the Ultra Screech ad. Imagine audio prompt is stems the same length as each clip, not the full 2:47. B-roll story arc, The Appointment Day: Lillith books hair appointments to get 'a little lift,' and every appointment meant to fix it makes it bigger, even the wash. The dried hair springs up into the skyline on the final chorus.
visualArc: Kenji tag on stage → Lillith verse / call one, a little lift → crown work at salon one → chorus hair-skyline → out the salon door → Rubella's six blocks under it → call two on speakerphone → the blowout at salon two → Kenji solo hair-blocks / call three, the phone rings inside the hair → bridge on stage → the wash → it dries into the skyline (drop) → skyline with a delivery → call four, Rubella hangs up → Kenji tag again.
